text:
Maya: quick poll  should the automatic fallback inbox surface every event or a compact sampled stream by default? noise vs. forensic needs.
Sam: compact by default. expand-to-playback for any important event. ops shouldn't be flooded during big spikes.
Owen: compact + guaranteed capture windows: canaries and policy-change windows should be 100% captured. also need retention policy (90d default?) for audits.
Jess: UI idea: two panes  'Critical' (always shown) and 'Sampled' (collapsible). filters: route, model, tenant, severity. quick actions per item: mute, escalate, export.
Kai: security concern: do we show the full "why_did_you_fallback" blob inline? that can leak request contents. propose showing a short summary tag + ACL-guarded trace link.
Sam: yep. surface summary_tag like "latency_tail", "5xx_spike", "quota_exceeded" and trace_url pointing to object store with ACL. index only minimal metadata. example index doc: decision_id=dec-20260401-07, trigger=5xx_spike, route=/api/v1/generate, fallback_chain=[model-v1, model-v2], summary="5xx rate > 2% over 1m"
Owen: sampling heuristics proposal: 100% for severity>=high, 10% for medium, 0.5% for low. enforce min capture 1 event/min per route so we don't miss steady-state signals. keeps index size manageable.
Maya: cost question  full traces are bulky. store metadata in index and push full traces to cold object storage on-demand. redact user content before persisting full traces by default.
Kai: metadata must include model version, input hash, quantization profile so decision replay is deterministic. also include policy config id that triggered fallback.
Jess: small UX nit: show a small sparkline per route for fallback rate and a severity badge. make operator actions 1-click where possible.
Sam: API changes: add fields severity, summary_tag, trace_url, decision_id, policy_id. expose /inbox with filters + cursor pagination and an export endpoint.
Owen: compliance: need an immutable audit export (NDJSON) for a requested time window. propose export_for_audit that materializes snapshots to org S3 path with signed URL and WORM flag.
Maya: add operator escape-hatch that records operator id + mandatory reason and is auditable.
Sam: implementation question: per-tenant sampling controls or infra-only?
Owen: customers will want per-tenant sampling (enterprise pays for retention). defaults at org-level, tenant overrides allowed for billed tiers.
AuditBot: created ticket AUD-912, retention matrix + export SLA attached.
DeployBot: deploy finished: feature/inbox-proto -> staging (build 2026.04.01.3) :rocket:
Sam: I'll put up a PR with schema + example payloads. tagging @Owen @Jess @Kai for review.
Jess: I'll mock the compact card and actions today.
Maya: plan: limited canary rollout to 5 tenants, monitor operator inbox load and export costs, iterate. :thumbsup:
